thread:
maria: Heads up — Berlin LLM Hackday confirmed for May 12-13. We have a 6x6 corner booth and a 20min speaking slot on Day 1. Starting a planning thread :tada:
aj: Awesome. Do we have a theme for the booth / talk yet?
sam: Suggestion — 'Serving LLMs at product scale' with a live demo of routing + fallback. Short demo + 2 slides.
logan: Booth Ops: need power (2x 110V), ethernet drop, and 1 high table + 2 stools. I can submit the order by Monday.
jenna: Swag inventory — what do we want? previous events: stickers, shirts, chargers. Recommendation: 200 stickers, 150 shirts (unisex S-XL mix), 250 promo pens, 100 card wallets. Thoughts? :shirt:
maria: Lean on lightweight, high-perceived-value items. Add 100 branded power banks instead of chargers? pricier but attracts leads.
aj: Power banks = yes but confirm budget. If over budget, do 100 enamel pins + 200 stickers.
sam: I can write a short talk abstract this afternoon. Will post draft here. Need speaker bio and headshot from maria.
maria: sending bio + headshot in DM. Quick note: run booth sign-up calendar for staffing slots (2 people per 3-hour window). Preference: 9am-6pm coverage across both days.
jenna: Shipping timeline: swag vendor needs final counts and vector art by April 20 for production. DHL pickup suggested for May 8 to hit venue by May 11. I can schedule if approved. :ship:
logan: AV: mic + small PA for presentations, HDMI adapter for laptop, 1 monitor for demo. Also requesting a small lockbox for devices.
aj: Lead capture + routing: we'll use QR that hits a short Typeform + Zap -> Salesforce. Each lead should tag source=berlin-hackday and route to SDR queue `EMEA_inbound`. Sam, can you add a URL param for demo interest?
sam: Yep — example: https://redwood.typeform.com/berlin?interest=demo
maria: Booth script (30s elevator): "Hi, we're Redwood Inference — we make inference predictable and affordable across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Want to see a 60s demo?" Simple variant for devs and for product folks.
jenna: Speaking logistics: organizer requires uploaded slides by May 1 and speaker check-in at 8:30am on Day 1. Sam, you ok with that?
sam: Confirmed. I’ll rehearse with maria next Wednesday at 10am.
logan: Can someone confirm we have permission to demo live model calls from the venue network? If not, plan B: pre-recorded demo + local mock server.
maria: Good catch — tagging ops to check. If network flaky, we use recorded sequence plus short local inference on laptop.
aj: Marketing assets: need booth banners (2x), one 85x200cm and one 60x160cm, and a one-pager PDF to hand out. Sam — can you provide a one-pager copy? Design to follow.
swag-bot: Reminder: vector logo files required by vendor: `redwood-logo.ai`, `redwood-wordmark.svg`. Upload link: https://drive.redwood.ai/events/berlin-assets
jenna: Budget ask: estimated total $7.2k (booth fees $3k + swag $2k + travel/accom $1.5k + misc $0.7k). Can we get approval from finance by Apr 10?
maria: I'll ping finance today and loop in CSM for travel approvals.
logan: Ops note — need two printed staff badges saying 'Speaker' and 'Team' for Sam and backup. Jenna can do printing.
sam: Quick Q: Will we run a giveaway? If so, need copy for form (consent to be contacted). Prize idea: a year of Redwood credits (or $3k run).
aj: Giveaway = yes. Put consent checkbox and opt-in copy. Prize fulfillment handled by finance + legal.
maria: Final checklist I’ll maintain: talk abstract, slides, demo checklist, swag order, shipping, banners, lead form, staffing rota. I’ll update this thread with links and statuses.
jenna: I booked DHL tentative pickup for May 8 and created purchase request for swag (PR-4221). Need final counts by Apr 20.
logan: Great. I'll book AV and power with venue today.
sam: Draft of talk abstract posted in doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/berlin-talk-draft — feedback welcome.
maria: Thanks team — next sync Weds 10am rehearsal + weekly standup Fridays 11am until event. :calendar:
__notes: This file is a single Slack thread for a marketing channel about Berlin hackday execution. Messages are short, informal, include emoji, links, and a small code-style reference per agents.md rules.
